notes.title: Patch Notes 1.3
notes.notes:
Today, we're excited to release Patch 1.3, which adds new content, such as a bonus post-credits scene, and includes a bevy of bug fixes and improvements. Learn about this latest update in the below patch notes. 

[h2]Patch 1.3[/h2]
[b]NEW! [/b]
[list]
[*] Bonus post-credits scene 
[*] Interactive content warning screen 
[*] “Skip text” feature, available after finishing the entire game 
[*] Global offset calibrator for rhythm minigames 
[*] Lane speed setting for Mania-like rhythm minigame 
[*] New videoke minigame song: Leron Leron Sinta 
[*] More graphics settings (reflections, SSAO, and an Off option for almost every setting) 
[*] Credits now accessible from the main menu at any time 
[/list]

[b]Fixes and improvements:  [/b]
[*] Fixed audio crackling in Windows 
[*] Improved general behavior of controller icons 
[*] Fixed gamepad icons appearing even though keyboard is in use 
[*] Fixed inconsistent timings in the jeepney minigame (but still as hard) 
[*] Fixed mouse clicks not registering in the League of Mashers minigame 
[*] Various visual improvements in the League of Mashers minigame 
[*] Fixed various soft-locks, especially those that occur under low framerates 
[*] Fixed FPS HUD not letting mouse clicks through 
[*] Fixed certain music tracks not looping 
[*] Fixed some English typographical errors 
[*] Fixed the “Fishballer” achievement not unlocking if player skewers more than one fishball in a single turn 
[*] Fixed some SFX and music tracks not respecting volume settings 
[*] Fixed Mark’s rare moonwalking/moonrunning in certain scenes 
[*] Improved intro music track 
[*] Improved gamepad navigation in scene selector 
[*] Fixed Mark’s chat messages possibly being sent more than once 
[*] Improved physics and feel of the web browser dinosaur minigame 

[b] Spoilers ahead! Fixes continued:  [/b]

[spoiler] 
[*] Fixed Mark’s arms in front of Nicole during their prom dance 
[*] Fixed erroneous physics when removing a certain pushpin in Part 1, Chapter 4 “Real Part” 
[*] Fixed the game not pausing after finishing a practice piece in Part 1, Chapter 5 “Last Practice” 
[*] Fixed the metronome setting of “100 Progressive Studies” in Part 1, Chapter 5 “Last Practice” 
[*] Fixed more than one Cathy appearing at the same time in Part 2, Chapter 5 “Audition Day” 
[*] Fixed the arrow icon getting stuck in Part 2, Chapter 5 “Save Me, Please” 
[*] Fixed Mark unnecessarily standing up in Part 3, Chapter 5 “Until Then” 
[*] Fixed visual artifacts of trees and branches in Part 3, Chapter 5 “Until Then” 
[/spoiler]

Thanks for playing! We appreciate your dedication and continual support for Until Then! 
Follow the [url=https://twitter.com/UntilThenGame]Until Then X account[/url] for all the latest updates!

notes.title: "A narrative cinematic masterpiece"
notes.notes:
First off, we appreciate each and every thoughtful review you all have left for Until Then! It goes a long way in ensuring others experience the beauty, depth and hard work that was poured into this stunning narrative adventure! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44417352/7de2dafc2fe1c89eceb7f4be73c602fbd9c88897.png[/img]

It's remarkable to see how this title has struck such an emotional chord with players. We wanted to share the incredible things press has to say thus far about Until Then:

[previewyoutube=cQ2Jw6OoT5g;full][/previewyoutube]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44417352/2d43283139f3a2becd1fec7c966beb450aea7a18.png[/img]

notes.title: Check out this visual novel that blends 3D and 2D visuals in a story about teens who've (mostly) avoided the end of the world
notes.notes: New visual novel Until Then is getting pretty dang positive reception not only for its story and characters, but also its distinctive visual style that blends 2D characters with 3D environments, as well as a unique use of social media as a plot element... Read more.

notes.title: A huge thank you to Until Then players!
notes.notes:
We wanted to take a minute to say a huge [b]THANK YOU[/b] to everyone who has played Until Then thus far! The outpouring of praise and support for the game has been incredibly touching and we are thrilled to see so many people sharing their gameplay experience. 

Quick Tip: For those who have finished one playthrough of the game, there may be more lingering after the credits...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44417352/d1542c6c92b904ec8b8b3910ad38dda8cb755173.jpg[/img]
We are paying close attention to all bug reports and issues, so stay tuned for a patch to be released next week to address as much of your input as we can. The best way to let us know about bugs is through Steam discussions or our [url=https://discord.gg/maxent]Discord channel[/url]. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44417352/f7c152bf94fc4067f270909340bd580dc3e20c7e.jpg[/img]
Our team at Polychroma Games has been hard at work on this game for over four years now, so you can imagine how exciting this week has been seeing the game finally get into your hands to get to know Mark, Cathy, and the gang whom we have been so close to for all this time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44417352/e37743e462a84c66f06f9df0059a468ae63a280e.jpg[/img]
We especially love this quote from [url=https://rectifygaming.com/review-until-then/]Rectify Gaming's review[/url], "Until Then is not just a game to be played; it’s an experience to be felt, remembered, and cherished for its ability to provoke thought and evoke emotion." We hope that you all enjoy the journey and relish every emotional up and down that it takes you on!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44417352/b8104854bf13613d7fe229ad9d1254fc15bd39ea.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Delay Announcement
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44417352/284e03f2c6138155e96461c01113b15ee756bf80.png[/img]


Hello fans of Mark, Cathy, and the Until Then crew!

We wanted to share a quick update on Until Then's release date. To ensure we deliver the best possible experience, we have made the decision to delay the game’s launch by just a few weeks. 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44417352/c7538b059c81abe52cc3cc8c184cb55b025fa1ef.gif[/img]

We know many of you are itching to play the rest of the story after experiencing the demo, so our team is hard at work to get this passion project into your hands as quickly as possible. You will be able to begin your adventure very soon this summer! 


[b][h3]New Release Date Coming Soon!
[/h3][/b]

We'll have more information to share soon and we appreciate your patience and understanding! In the meantime, we hope you’re enjoying your first foray into Mark’s high school life in the free demo which is still available for download.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2024/03/cinematic-narrative-adventure-until-then-releases-may-23rd

notes.title: Until Then Releases May 23 on Steam
notes.notes:
We’re excited to announce that Until Then was just featured in The MIX’s Spring Games Showcase. Check out the release date trailer for more hints of the intriguing mysteries of the world of Until Then. Beyond the beautiful Philippines-inspired landscapes, hints of disappearances, moments of déjà vu that just don’t add up, and other abnormalities point to things being not quite what they seem. Can you weave through the mysteries before all is lost?


[previewyoutube=j2vIkYQdCZA;full][/previewyoutube]


Stay tuned for more updates! 

Until then...

notes.title: Play piano, blag your book report, and navigate high school crushes in this gorgeous Philippines-inspired indie game
notes.notes:
If you played and liked last year's excellent slice-of-life adventure A Space For The Unbound, stop what you're doing and go and download the Steam Next Fest demo for Until Then. Go on, I'll wait. Right, sorted? Let's continue. Like A Space For The Unbound, Until Then is a coming of age story where the ups and downs of everyday high school life start intermingling with strange, supernatural occurences.
